Track basic recruiting metrics (e.g., time-to-fill, applicant flow, source effectiveness) and identify opportunities to improve. Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Outlook (communication/scheduling), Word (letters/forms), and Excel (tracking and basic reporting). Preferred Experience recruiting in janitorial, facilities, hospitality, manufacturing, or similar industries. Familiarity with applicant tracking systems (ATS) and/or HRIS platforms.
